checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Add the stored chunk reference to each encoded position offset, reconstruct its world 6D orientation, solve IK, and compare FK against the demonstrated commanded TCP pose in metres/radians plus the gripper scalar. The fixed reference subtraction/addition is exactly invertible; IK convergence, residuals and limit contacts remain explicit.

contract.cut_relation: All twelve assigned [740,1270) segments are unchanged. Every action remains supervised, preserving the 210-action incoming [740,950) and 150-action outgoing [1120,1270) overlaps. The object-selective coordinates refine representation without changing responsibility, timing, labels or success criteria.
contract.output_semantics: Each prediction slot is [world-axis TCP position offset xyz in metres from the active reference point fixed at causal chunk start, world-frame TCP rotation as the first two rotation-matrix columns (6D), native gripper scalar]. Training subtracts the same chunk reference from FK of each demonstrated joint command in all 16 slots. Decode adds that fixed reference, projects 6D rotation by safe Gram-Schmidt, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. The lid-handle reference covers release; the peg-center reference makes post-release approach, grasp and lift translation-equivariant at each replan. Slots are t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1 through 8. Gripper values >=0 open and values <0 close.
contract.parameter_semantics: No high-level arguments. The executor supplies two causal observations, oldest first. At every 8-action replan, the newest observed state selects and resolves a chunk-fixed world translation reference: the observed lid-handle point only while the peg is low, TCP-to-handle distance is at most 0.10 m, and finger width is below 0.07 m; otherwise the observed peg center. Only the initial episode observation may be duplicated for padding.
